title: Supports Fusion of 5 Reference Images and Intelligent Expansion. xAI Imagine Image2.0 is Now Officially Launched

content_html:
xAI launched Imagine Image 2.0, a new quality mode for the Web-based Imagine service and iOS and Android apps under Grok, focusing on creative scenarios that require controllable layout, clear fonts, and consistent visual elements. The model's API access plan is currently being developed but has not been officially released yet.

xAI stated that Image 2.0 can understand complex instructions, complete font and layout planning in dense compositions, and maintain clarity of small text. At the same time, the model supports multi-turn generation and editing, preserving user-specified visual elements during repeated adjustments. Its editing tools support precise selection of image areas through the magic wand and segmentation features, enabling local modifications without affecting other parts. It also supports background removal, export of transparent images, and the ability to generate a single image combining up to five reference images, reducing manual synthesis costs in complex visual creation.

In addition, Image 2.0 introduces an intelligent resizing feature that can expand images to specified frame sizes, supporting ratios from 1:2 to 9:16, as well as square, horizontal, and 2:1 formats. xAI also introduced template workflows for repetitive creative tasks, covering scenarios such as photo editing, product color adjustment, e-commerce images, professional avatars, icons, character sprites, emojis, and product design.

In video planning scenarios, the relevant templates can help users generate characters, scenes, and props separately while maintaining a consistent visual style, thus building a continuous and consistent content world.

content_html_zh:
xAI推出了Imagine Image 2.0，这是一种新的质量模式，适用于Grok旗下基于Web的Imagine服务以及iOS和Android应用程序，专注于需要可控布局、清晰字体和一致视觉元素的创意场景。 该模型的API接入方案目前正在制定中，但尚未正式发布。

xAI表示，Image 2.0可以理解复杂的指令，在密集的构图中完成字体和布局规划，并保持小文本的清晰度。 同时，该模型支持多轮生成和编辑，在反复调整过程中保留用户指定的视觉元素。 其编辑工具支持通过魔棒和分割功能精确选择图像区域，从而实现局部修改而不影响其他部分。 它还支持背景去除、透明图像导出，以及最多组合五个参考图像生成单个图像的能力，从而减少复杂视觉创建中的手动合成成本。

此外，Image 2.0还引入了智能缩放功能，可以将图像扩展至指定的帧尺寸，支持从1:2到9:16的比例，以及方形、水平和2:1格式。 xAI还推出了针对重复性创意任务的模板工作流程，涵盖照片编辑、产品调色、电商图片、专业头像、图标、角色精灵、表情符号和产品设计等场景。

在视频策划场景中，相关模板可以帮助用户分别生成人物、场景、道具，同时保持一致的视觉风格，从而构建一个连续一致的内容世界。
